## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: dangerous driving behaviors: alcohol and drugs, implied consent, distracted and drowsy driving
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The marijuana sentence cites unnamed studies; it is restated as the handbook's claim without adding figures [A01].
The implied consent paragraph mentions other consequences of refusal without naming them; only the arrest and the at-least-one-year loss of privileges are stated [A01].
The second page ends with an unrelated public-service advertisement, which was not used [A02].
No dynamic, time-variable facts appear in these pages.
